checks.lean: example {α : Type*} (τ : LeanCraftGame.Topology.MyTopology α) (h : T12.MyCompact τ) (C : Set (Set α)) (ho : ∀ s ∈ C, τ.IsOpen s) (hc : (⋃₀ C) = Set.univ) : ∃ F : Finset (Set α), (↑F : Set (Set α)) ⊆ C ∧ (⋃₀ (↑F : Set (Set α))) = Set.univ := h C ho hc
checks.message: Your predicate must apply directly to any open cover and produce a finite subcover.
Every finite topological space, including Bool, is compact.
The usual infinite discrete topology on Nat is not compact.
The infinite cofinite space on Nat is compact by a general theorem, not a finite check.

checks.lean: example {α β : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] [CompactSpace α] (f : α → β) (hf : Continuous f) : IsCompact (f '' Set.univ) := isCompact_univ.image hf
checks.message: Continuous images of compact spaces are compact.

steps: Start with `∀ C : Set (Set α)`, and assume every member is open and `⋃₀ C = univ`.
hints.hint: Finish with `∃ F : Finset (Set α), (↑F : Set (Set α)) ⊆ C ∧ (⋃₀ (↑F : Set (Set α))) = Set.univ`.
Reuse the same finite-subcover conclusion; the extra premises simply appear in a different order.
